body_markdown:
**Fort Lauderdale, FL (August 20, 2026)** —[Amerant Bank](http://www.amerantbank.com/) , Florida’s bank of choice, and Fort Lauderdale United FC today announced that the venue on Nova Southeastern University’s campus will now be known as **Amerant Bank Field** .


The naming rights designation reflects a shared commitment to investing in South Florida, supporting the growth of professional sports, and creating meaningful community experiences throughout the region.


The designation of Amerant Bank Field represents our continued commitment to Broward County and South Florida, highlighting the role that sports venues play in bringing communities together and creating opportunities for connection, engagement, and regional growth.


Tommy Smith, Founder and Chairman of Fort Lauderdale United FC shared, “Renaming our home Amerant Bank Field at Nova Southeastern University represents another important step forward for Fort Lauderdale and the future we’re building here. Amerant Bank shares our commitment to investing in this community, and we’re proud to have their name associated with a venue that will continue creating meaningful experiences for South Florida.”


The addition of Amerant Bank Field reinforces Amerant’s presence in South Florida sports, strengthening its connection with local communities while supporting organizations that drive economic development, community engagement, and opportunities for future generations.


As Fort Lauderdale United FC continues its growth and development, Amerant Bank Field will serve as a centerpiece for professional soccer, youth development initiatives, and community events in Broward County.


For more information about Amerant Bank, visit[amerantbank.com](http://amerantbank.com/) and follow on[Facebook](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3317184-1&h=583103474&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FAmerantBank%2F&a=Facebook) ,[Twitter](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3317184-1&h=648704292&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Famerantbank&a=Twitter) ,[Instagram](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3317184-1&h=2132424239&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Famerantbank%2F&a=Instagram) and[LinkedIn](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3317184-1&h=2272791785&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Famerantbank%2Fmycompany%2F&a=LinkedIn) @AmerantBank.

**About Fort Lauderdale United FC**


Fort Lauderdale United FC is South Florida’s first and only professional women’s soccer club competing in the Gainbridge Super League with a men’s team set to debut in USL League One in 2027. Together with its youth development programs, Fort Lauderdale United FC is building a connected soccer organization designed to grow the game and create a lasting connection with communities across South Florida.
